narr.coordination: The SitRep states that response activities in the affected provinces are being supported through the technical pillars. On vaccination, 470 contacts at high risk (PPL) have been vaccinated in Haut-Uélé and 938 in Ituri, where 5,900 doses of Ervebo vaccine were received; in Bas-Uélé the provincial Ervebo stock is at 0 doses.
narr.resistance: 32 EDS failures due to resistance in Ituri (Bambu, Nia-Nia, Tchomia, Mangala, Mandima)
narr.security: The Avakubi PoC in Ituri remains non-functional due to insecurity, the Butuhe PoC in Nord-Kivu has been non-functional since the security incident of 26/09/2026 with the threat against providers on the Butembo axis persisting, and in Bas-Uélé insufficient support from security services to PoE/PoC activities was noted.
